changed: The About screen has a new tagline, "Your caller's box, in the palm of your hand", translated into every supported language, and the Linux launcher uses it too.
The About screen shows the full version, including a beta suffix, once under the app name. It is no longer repeated in the line at the bottom or on the licenses page.
The status line under Check for updates now shows the full version, including a beta suffix, like the About screen does.
The licence is now written "AGPL-3.0-only" everywhere in the app, including the licenses page and the Windows and macOS app details.
